assessment: Agent-performed source review under user authorization. The production server has no configured external worker, subprocess or dynamic-library execution path; mediasoup starts an in-process thread and calls mediasoup_worker_run, whose DTLS transport uses the authenticated static OpenSSL archive. The reviewed server does not invoke iconv/gconv or locale-module conversion APIs. Built-in files/dns NSS and the restricted loader profile remove the configured optional plugin routes. On 2026-09-30, two agents independently reviewed the complete source delta from tree d04457098724b7f326d3e6416c19e250fb98f60f to the recorded src tree: only auth/passkeys.rs and auth/webauthn.rs changed. Passkey replacement reuses existing WebAuthn registration/verification, system randomness, SHA-256 and SQLx paths; credential replacement, recovery preparation, session revocation and challenge deadlines introduce no process, dynamic-library, locale-conversion or DTLS execution path. Every vendor tree, dependency/native manifest and profile binding remained unchanged in that review. On 2026-10-03, explicitly re-reviewed the native manifest and OpenSSL installer delta from b53281d23675be071e737a06c127413540017086 to ca31288a641050eb59b77955a5d7e57bc58d4209. Only openssl.installer_sha256 changed in the native manifest: the installer replaces tar extraction with Python's data-filtered extraction after verifying the same archive SHA-256. OpenSSL 3.5.9, its authenticated source archive, static build options, build/install steps and recorded disabled settings remain unchanged. Every reviewed application/vendor tree, Cargo dependency binding, vendor integrity manifest and runtime profile remains identical. The extraction change adds no server execution path, dynamic loading, locale conversion or DTLS behavior; only this exact native-manifest identity is renewed, retaining the original 2026-11-29 expiry and managed-server scope. This assessment concerns the intended server DTLS path, not unused libc/libuv APIs, engine-provided init, administrator-selected programs or arbitrary post-deployment mutation. Changed source trees, dependency/native manifests or profile bytes require explicit re-review; no automatic renewal.
